freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 注册阶跃星辰开放平台后在控制台创建 API Key，即可通过 OpenAI 兼容的 Chat Completions 接口调用 Step 系列模型。官方定价页把 stepaudio-3 的 realtime / chat / gen / music 四个 Preview 语音模型标注为「限时免费」，未充值账号（V0）也能调用，限速并发 5、RPM 10、TPM 500 万。Step Plan 订阅另提供 Claude Code 兼容端点；赠送额度与免费体验活动以控制台为准。
freeTierSummary.en: Create an API key in the StepFun console to call the Step model family over the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint. Official pricing marks four stepaudio-3 preview voice models (realtime / chat / gen / music) as limited-time free, usable on a never-recharged V0 account at 5 concurrent, 10 RPM, 5M TPM. Step Plan adds an Anthropic-compatible endpoint.
